recommended_next_experiment.rationale: The smallest honest next step. A Path-3 training-strength sweep is contraindicated: the autopsy explains why a local tagger cannot become selective without a varying input. The real gate is upstream z_world separation.

learning_extracted: Path 3 replaced the slot-SELECTION mechanism (q.k -> feedforward MLP) but not the selection INPUT (z_world); the z_world cross-context collapse (418f cosine 0.998) is upstream of every SD-016 selection path, so the mechanism swap could not help.

The slight entropy movement (ln(16)=2.7726 -> 2.7536) is cosmetic: a random-init MLP yields non-uniform but FIXED logits (off the static saddle), not context-selective logits. The C1b context-divergence instrument (~0.0021) is the load-bearing metric and is what a C1-entropy-only design would have missed.
418m cannot discriminate input-impoverishment from wrong-abstraction-level because the confound masks both; classification is ambiguous with impoverishment dominant and sufficient.

Biological refinement (load-bearing, recorded as design note not build): vmPFC/OFC loads content; relational/event INDEXING is hippocampal. SD-016's selectable units may need to be hippocampal event/outcome nodes, with SD-016 retained as the cue-facing interface. Gated behind z_world separation + a demonstrated semantic-arbitrariness signal.
A tagger LR/temperature/duration sweep would push C1 entropy down while making C1b WORSE (sharper fixed selection = less context dependence) -- contraindicated, not deferred.
